meta.title: Choosing Request Condition "Material Creation" reveals Category and Subcategory fields

args.goal: On the current Create Intake Request page, enter a request title, verify Category and Subcategory fields and their dropdown controls are not visible before choosing a condition, select Request Condition "Material Creation", then verify both Category and Subcategory fields are visible and each offers a dropdown of values; stop on the form showing the revealed fields

steps.note: Performs the unmodeled intake-request interaction and directly observes the before-and-after field visibility and dropdown availability.
Confirms the resulting intake-request screen has no crash, server error, raw IDs, or invalid rendering.
